title: Starship & Vehicle
description: A comprehensive schema for starships and vehicles with narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the starship or vehicle.

starship_type.description: The primary category of the starship or vehicle.

class.description: The specific class or model designation.

era.description: The primary era this starship is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

manufacturer.description: The company or organization that built this starship.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the starship, its history, significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this starship.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this starship is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: The main descriptive text for the starship, providing comprehensive details.

physical_description.description: Detailed physical description of the starship's appearance, design, and construction.

manufacturing_location.description: Where this starship was typically manufactured or assembled.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Manufactured By', 'Iconic To', 'Common Among', 'Deployed By', 'Designed For'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this starship from Star Wars canon.

famous_pilots.description: Notable individuals who have piloted or commanded this type of starship.

famous_battles.description: Notable battles or events involving this type of starship.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this starship.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this starship.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this starship.

typical_missions.description: Types of missions or tasks typically performed with this starship.

cultural_impact.description: How this starship affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

technological_significance.description: The technological implications and significance of this starship.

silhouette.description: The size category of the starship (1-10 scale).

health.description: Health and damage tracking for the starship.

systems.description: Technical systems and capabilities of the starship.

navicomputer.description: Whether the starship has a navicomputer.

weapons.description: Weapon systems installed on the starship.

slots.description: Available modification slots, categorized by system.

compatible_mods.description: List of modification IDs that can be installed on this starship.

passenger_capacity.description: Number of passengers the starship can carry.

cargo_capacity.description: Description of cargo capacity and storage.

consumables.description: How long the starship can operate without resupply.

crew_stations.description: Available crew positions and their capabilities.

available_actions.description: Actions available to this crew station.

skill_requirements.description: Skills required to operate this station effectively.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this starship, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this starship adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Location', 'Combat_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this starship is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the starship's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the starship's icon for UI display.

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this starship.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this starship.
